text: Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Auditor, Grant Thornton LLP, has provided their Letter to Management; it was not available when the 2023 Audited Consolidated Financial Statements were approved by the Board in April.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the Auditor's Letter to Management, as presented in Attachment 1 to the report (July 4, 2024) from the Director, Finance, Toronto Atmospheric Fund, for information.
